maria: Quick heads-up — onboarding `7b4-int8` to staging; I see a consistent prefill-boundary misalignment when streaming + concatenating prefixes.
aj: Details?
maria: Minimal repro: run `python tools/repro_prefill.py --model 7b4-int8 --prefix "[USER]" --stream`; observe 2-token gap and duplicate token emitted when prefix length isn't aligned to 32-token tile.
chen: Can you paste the exact log snippet?
maria: ```
[2024-11-21 14:02:01] prefill: tokens=1536, tile_size=32, last_tile=31
[2024-11-21 14:02:01] kv_index: start=1504, end=1535
[2024-11-21 14:02:01] stream: emitted duplicate at pos=1506 -> "and"
```
aj: Huh — duplication at tile boundary. Does it happen on FP16 too?
maria: FP16 staging doesn't show duplication. Quantized int8 variant does. Also shows subtle LM score jump at concat points (0.6->0.8).
sam: @chen any idea if quantized memcpy/prefill padding could shift the kv_index?
chen: I'll check allocator/prefill path. My first guess is a rounding of prefill length in the int8 kernel path: `prefill_len = (len+pad)//tile_size*tile_size` mismatch.
eva: Could also be related to prefix caching + streaming where we rehydrate KV for the prefix and then append fresh tokens without resync.
infra-bot: Deploy recorded: staging/7b4-int8@2024-11-21T14:05:00 by maria
maria: Next steps: 1) unit test for misaligned prefix concat 2) run reproduce across GPUs (a100, h100) 3) try int8-only memcpy fix from chen
aj: I'll add a canary eval with long-context QA benchmark to track regressions. Will share dashboard link.
chen: started a small branch `fix/prefill-align` — pushing logs in ~30m.
maria: Thanks all. If someone can confirm on an H100 that would be great — I'm seeing slightly different behavior across archs.
